hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding-curve token launch hook (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) that implements a Uniswap v4-native constant-product curve with an ERC20 quote token. Features include block+1 anti-snipe, 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, 1% dynamic LP fee split 70/30 creator/platform, and in-place graduation to a full-range standard Uniswap v4 pool upon reaching the raise target.
